stepTitle: Consider the function $$f(x)=\sin(x)$$ restricted to the domain $$\left[\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right].$$ Which of the following is the graph of the inverse of $$f?$$ \n Three graphs labeled A, B, and C, each showing a curve with domain from negative $$1$$ to $$1$$ on the horizontal axis. Panel A: a decreasing curve from the point negative $$1$$ comma $$3$$ pi over $$2$$ to the point $$1$$ comma pi over $$2$$. Panel B: an increasing curve from the point negative $$1$$ comma pi over $$2$$ to the point $$1$$ comma $$3$$ pi over 2; a vertical shift by pi of the graph in C. Panel C: an increasing curve from the point negative $$1$$ comma negative pi over $$2$$ to the point $$1$$ comma pi over $$2$$.
choices: The function is not invertible, and thus has no graph.
